label: The lambda model
subgoals: Identify the shortening of the effective channel past pinch-off
Multiply the saturation current by one plus lambda times V_DS
Note that lambda grows as the channel shortens

label: Output resistance
subgoals: Differentiate the lambda model with respect to V_DS
Invert lambda times the drain current

label: Intrinsic gain
subgoals: Write gm as two I_D over the overdrive
Multiply by r_o equal to one over lambda I_D
Simplify to two over lambda times the overdrive
